## 3. One question for counsel to ask her in the briefing

**The surveying of the lot that went to the barangay.** Jonathan recalls surveyors on the Balane lot and a barangay blotter about it. No record of it is in our files. Ask her, in the briefing only:

1. Did she see surveyors working on the Balane lot? When (month and year)?

2. Who was with them, and who was directing them?

3. Was it reported to Barangay San Roque, by whom, and does she have the certification?

Why it matters: Gloria's title rests on a plan surveyed on **8 September 2020** by Geodetic Engineer Christopher D. Mangiga, certified as made "with the full knowledge and consent of the owner(s)," three years after the only agent died. A blotter showing that survey contested on the ground, and who directed it, supports the partition ground and the good-faith point. It is not in her affidavit, so it does not come in through her on direct; it comes in by a certified copy of the blotter page on rebuttal, or on re-direct only if cross opens it. If she has the certification, counsel keeps it.
